meta.title: NFL.com division standings, 2026 regular season (live, retrieved 2026-11-13)
meta.method: Values transcribed from the W, L, T, PF and PA columns of the official division standings table on the page above. This is a live page: the values below are a point-in-time snapshot and will change as games are played.
meta.note: The committed dataset (data/derived/games.csv.gz) ends at gameday 2026-11-01, so this snapshot is expected to be ahead of a rebuild over the extract. The difference is measured and reported, not smoothed over: see verification/integration_recompute.json.
meta.cross_check: The same page's Week 10 injury report shows Washington at 3-5-1 and New York (Giants) at 5-3-1, matching the standings rows transcribed here.
